body.intent: Fix An agent session's actor record is written once per checkout, not once per run, so a ship run's branch ends up with two record change sets adding the same actor handle and its review/code step fails rhiza check with 'duplicate handle'. Seen twice on 2026-11-04: usage governor (claude-code-a463ece8) and text references (claude-code-83858632: recorded uncommitted in the run worktree as change set 01M6KE23, then again in the verifier checkout as 01M6KFMJ, both committed). Make actor stamping idempotent across a run's worktree and checkouts (look up the handle in the branch, the run worktree and main before adding), or have rhiza check/land merge identical actor records
